SERVICE_EXPORTED_CONFIGS - Static variable in interface org.osgi.test.cases.remoteserviceadmin.common.RemoteServiceConstants
A list of configuration types that should be used to export the service.
SERVICE_EXPORTED_INTENTS - Static variable in interface org.osgi.test.cases.remoteserviceadmin.common.RemoteServiceConstants
A list of intents that the distribution provider must implement to distribute the service.
SERVICE_EXPORTED_INTENTS_EXTRA - Static variable in interface org.osgi.test.cases.remoteserviceadmin.common.RemoteServiceConstants
Extra intents configured in addition to the the intents specified in RemoteServiceConstants.SERVICE_EXPORTED_INTENTS .These intents are merged with the service.exported.intents and therefore have the same semantics.
SERVICE_EXPORTED_INTERFACES - Static variable in interface org.osgi.test.cases.remoteserviceadmin.common.RemoteServiceConstants
Defines the interfaces under which this service can be exported.
SERVICE_IMPORTED - Static variable in interface org.osgi.test.cases.remoteserviceadmin.common.RemoteServiceConstants
Must be set by a distribution provider to true when it registers the end-point proxy as an imported service.
SERVICE_IMPORTED_CONFIGS - Static variable in interface org.osgi.test.cases.remoteserviceadmin.common.RemoteServiceConstants
The configuration information used to import this services, as described in RemoteServiceConstants.SERVICE_EXPORTED_CONFIGS.
SERVICE_INTENTS - Static variable in interface org.osgi.test.cases.remoteserviceadmin.common.RemoteServiceConstants
A list of intents that this service implements.
